package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    boolean enabled,
    Boolean maybe,
    String alwaysTrue,
    String alwaysFalse,
    Void nothing,
    List<Boolean> flags
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (Boolean) map.get("enabled"),
            (Boolean) map.get("maybe"),
            (String) map.get("alwaysTrue"),
            (String) map.get("alwaysFalse"),
            (Void) map.get("nothing"),
            (List<Boolean>) map.get("flags")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("enabled", enabled);
        map.put("maybe", maybe);
        map.put("alwaysTrue", alwaysTrue);
        map.put("alwaysFalse", alwaysFalse);
        map.put("nothing", nothing);
        map.put("flags", flags);
        return map;
    }
}
